text: The two tests that check this repository's own hand-ratified locks, TestTheRepositorysHandLocksHold and TestTheRepositorysLocksRatifiedByHandHold, skip where the code isn't a git checkout, saying why (#362). The plumbing sandbox copies the checkout without .git, so it tracks no locks and the ratification check can't find the journal there; every factory build touching internal/decisions or cmd/invariant failed on them, as #358's first did. CI runs both in its checkout, as does every clone.
